candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order 503s and gateway checkout 502s after ~2s timeouts.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side metrics or pool saturation time series; pool size/idle values come only from client span attributes.

report.explanation: Traces show all checkout failures originate at postgres.save_order with pool size 5 and 0 idle, DependencyUnavailable, propagating to order 503 and gateway 502; inventory and payment calls succeed. Gateway metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms order->postgresql dependency.
